text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd get injured...
This is bad news... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...No, the injury itself isn't a big deal.
The real problem is my fortune.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
An injury is an omen of tribulation!
Lord Shiraoki must be warning me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Just imagining what kind of terrible things
await me is so, so terrifying~.
choice_data_list: Faint heart invites bad luck, you know.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. At times like this, shutting myself aw—
Er, nurturing one's luck is the best thing to do!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled!
Let's head home while scattering salt and sacred sake!
I told her that pushing too hard was no good, and made her rest for a while...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Timidness, absolutely bad...!
Aggressiveness, good probably...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah!!
There's no way I can act confident after all~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I must be completely covered
in negative energy by now~!"

Making such a fuss aggravated the injury,
and several days of rest were needed...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew... By a narrow margin,
I managed to defeat my cowardly self...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'll focus on healing my injuries completely!
Once I do, this look of misfortune should vanish too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided,
I must prepare an amulet to speed up the recovery!!

While dedicating herself to recovery,
Matikanefukukitaru was fired up for her next training session!
